claim: Campaign blast holes are wider than one body and ragged, with sloped floors and ceilings: of the 185 pieces kept in sewer-study_breach_shapes.json, 137 have a slanted edge, 116 a sloped floor and 123 a sloped ceiling. Gravesend's scale.py records a median 1,280 wide and 1.45 bodies open (upper quartile 1,792 and 1.81), counted 2026-11-18 over 177 holes by a sweep not kept and not reproduced; a recount of the 96 kept holes (2026-11-26) gives a median 1,664 wide (quartiles 1,280 and 2,208) and 1.57 bodies open (upper quartile 1.95). E3M4's 640-wide hole (wall 2361) is too narrow for a ragged hole a body walks through.
